ctx.x: He said, come on, let's have some champagne now. I said, thank you, Bechet, that's nice. That's nice. So that's what happened with Bechet. That's Bechet, he was special. Real special man.

Well, you know, that's a very interesting thing, since we're on the subject, because a lot of people tend to think that many of the guys like Stepen Fetchit, Louis Armstrong, who came out of that area, were Uncle Tom's. They were strategists.
